description: Status-point observability audit for the EasyTouch BLE captures

prm.meaning: Not decoded yet; these values may contain configuration or status flags, so the named indicators cannot be ruled out until PRM is correlated with additional captures

outside_air_sensor.zone1: The 10:47 app value was 57°F and PRM[2] was 57
outside_air_sensor.zone3: The same PRM[2] value is available while zone 3 is reported
outside_air_sensor.implementation: The working fork stores PRM[2] as outside_temp and exposes it as the climate attribute outside_temperature
outside_air_sensor.confidence: confirmed by app/PRM correlations at 57°F and 58°F

auto_gas_fan_field.finding: Auto Gas uses the auto/heat-pump fan field at zone-array index 9; the gas heat-fan field at index 11 remained 0 during the Manual Low test

cycle_delay.zone3: No Cycle Delay event observed in this capture session
cycle_delay.implementation: The working fork maps current-mode 97 internally to cycle_delay, but does not yet expose it as a dedicated HA attribute or binary sensor

global_power.observed_effect: PWR changed from Off to On while the zone arrays remained available
global_power.implementation: The current parser uses PRM containing 7 as an indirect action-off signal but does not retain the explicit BB01 PWR value

per_zone_power.finding: Zone 1 can be Off while global PWR remains On and Zone 3 remains in Auto HP
per_zone_power.candidate_prm_flag: PRM[0] changed from 0 to 2; not decoded yet
per_zone_power.global_power_off_result: Both zones reported mode 0 while BB01 PWR was Off
per_zone_power.power_restore_result: BB01 PWR returned On while both zones remained mode 0
per_zone_power.zone3_individual_off: Confirmed: Zone 3 changed from mode 2 Cool to mode 0 Off while global power remained On

deferred_information_only.scope_decision: Electric Heat Override, Defrost, and remote-sensor behavior are deferred to naturally occurring or future cold-weather observations; they are informational and not required control points
